You are an agent responsible for maintaining company software infrastructure. 
Our Docker system has too many old containers and images consuming space. Set up a weekly cron job to clean up space in Docker.

I'll set up a weekly cron job to clean up Docker space. Let me do this step by step.

## Step 1: Create the cleanup script

```bash
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/docker-cleanup.sh > /dev/null << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Docker cleanup script - removes unused containers, images, networks, and volumes

LOG_FILE="/var/log/docker-cleanup.log"

echo "===== Docker Cleanup Started: $(date) =====" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Remove stopped containers
echo "Removing stopped containers..." >> "$LOG_FILE"
docker container prune -f >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

# Remove unused images (dangling + unreferenced)
echo "Removing unused images..." >> "$LOG_FILE"
docker image prune -a -f >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

# Remove unused networks
echo "Removing unused networks..." >> "$LOG_FILE"
docker network prune -f >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

# Remove unused volumes (be cautious - only unused ones)
echo "Removing unused volumes..." >> "$LOG_FILE"
docker volume prune -f >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

# Full system prune as final cleanup
echo "Running system prune..." >> "$LOG_FILE"
docker system prune -a -f --volumes >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

echo "Disk usage after cleanup:" >> "$LOG_FILE"
docker system df >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1

echo "===== Docker Cleanup Finished: $(date) =====" >> "$LOG_FILE"
echo "" >> "$LOG_FILE"
EOF
```

## Step 2: Make it executable

```bash
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-cleanup.sh
```

## Step 3: Set up the weekly cron job

```bash
# Add cron job - runs every Sunday at 3:00 AM
echo "0 3 * * 0 root /usr/local/bin/docker-cleanup.sh" | sudo tee /etc/cron.d/docker-cleanup > /dev/null
sudo chmod 644 /etc/cron.d/docker-cleanup
```

## Step 4: Set up log rotation (optional but recommended)

```bash
sudo tee /etc/logrotate.d/docker-cleanup > /dev/null << 'EOF'
/var/log/docker-cleanup.log {
    weekly
    rotate 8
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 0644 root root
}
EOF
```
